Elements
66 records

Chemical elements distinct from ores, alloys, and waste streams.

Minerals
427 records

Naturally occurring crystalline inorganic substances with defined IMA mineral status.

Secondary Resources
111 records

Post-consumer and industrial byproducts including spent batteries, slags, red mud, and scrap.

Commodities
36 records

Aggregated commercial products, traded raw materials, and manufactured chemical compounds.

Primary Resources
31 records

Raw unrefined geological deposits, mined ores, and run-of-mine materials.

Mineral Groups
7 records

Mineral supergroups and solid-solution series sharing related crystal structures.

Bioleaching
185 mechanisms

Microbial solubilization and mobilization of target metals from ores, concentrates, and wastes.

Biomineralization
107 mechanisms

Biological precipitation, crystallization, and synthesis of mineral phases or nanoparticles.

Redox Transformation
61 mechanisms

Oxidation-reduction reactions that alter metal valence states; microbial involvement is specified in each record.

Biosorption
17 mechanisms

Passive binding and retention of metal ions by microbial cell walls and biomass.

Separation
31 mechanisms

Selective partitioning by biological or abiotic processes. See each record for microbial involvement, experimental conditions and recovery limits.

Recovery
19 mechanisms

Integrated microbial processing schemes yielding concentrated or isolated materials.

Other Transformations
186 mechanisms

Complex community transformations, multi-stage processes, or unclassified interactions.

Acanthite

Acanthite is the monoclinic silver sulfide mineral Ag2S, listed as grandfathered with original-description year 1855 in the September 2026 IMA master list. It is distinct from elemental silver, generic silver-containing nanoparticles and the high-temperature cubic Ag2S form commonly called argentite. A laboratory bacterial study identifies acanthite as a minority particle type within a mixed silver-containing population. No criticality designation is inherited from silver.
